BSA celebrates Victory Day 2019
2019-12-18T00:00:00+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/bsa-celebrates-victory-day-2019-1841587

On the occasion of Victory Day, Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy held two separate programmes -- one at the National Memorial premises in Savar and another at their National Theatre Hall. Paying tributes to the martyrs of the Liberation War, over 500 artists, poets, singers, actors and acrobats performed in a cultural show at the National Memorial premises. The programme featured Baul songs, poetry recitations and an art camp, among other things. A discussion and cultural programme was followed at the National Theatre Hall of BSA, where renowned human rights activist Sultana Kamal spoke. Liaquat Ali Lucky, Director General of BSA, presided over the programme.
